purpose: Evaluate failure modes on longer, real-document excerpts, not force a target score.
model_access: Existing user login; no credential export or purchased service.
iteration_limit: At most one additional optimized prompt candidate, motivated by recorded dev failures. No test predictions used for selection.
selection_rule: Compare automatic end-to-end F1 first, require no increase in failed requests; use verdict macro F1 as secondary diagnostic. Retain compact-v1 on an F1 tie. Explicit semantic review may explain scorer artifacts but does not silently replace automatic selection scores.
test_rule: Freeze data, source code, prompt mapping and configuration before one scheduled pass per method on test. No reruns or label/prompt edits based on test results.
reporting: Automatic scores mandatory; any AI-assisted review alongside automatic scores. No human or independent adjudication is claimed. Token totals include CLI overhead; USD unknown for subscription access.
gold_review: Provide a per-case workbook. Author human sign-off remains pending; test scores against this draft reference, if run, must be labeled provisional. Human corrections later need a new dataset version, not retroactive test tuning.
